parent_established: N7 packaged structural retrieval+negative answers was not robust across two fresh schedules; N9 separates the components rather than promoting the package
role: exploratory factorial diagnosis on exposed development, not blind confirmation
selection: DEV44,2..35mentions; within each topic minimize N3/N7/N8 document exposure count then SHA256(N9::20261028::docID); choose hash-min10topics by SHA256(N9::20261028::topic::topicID)

factors.R0: sample3 demos without replacement from the identical structurally admissible outside-topic bank using Random(seed::docID)
factors.R1: unchanged N3/N7 select_demonstrations top3 structural ranking
factors.N0: all positive answer rows from selected demonstration
factors.N1: same exact demo ID, text, prompt and positive answer rows as paired N0, append at most4 negative_pairs in both directions; no replacement or synthesized rationale

fixed_fusion: (L_ab+L_ba+d1_ab+d1_ba)/4>=0.39; ordered pair controls, unordered decisions counted twice consistently

generation_transport.mixing: each document batch contains all four conditions, both schedules and3reads; shuffle order with Random(N9::mixed-batch::20261028::docID)
generation_transport.freshness: unique custom_id hash per logical generation; no body-keyed de-duplication or response cache; identical request bodies submitted separately; require240distinct served responseIDs
generation_transport.GET_polling: idempotent inherited GETpolling of submitted batch IDs, no repeat POST

primary_family.metric: compute each condition micro-F1 on its full cohort in each schedule; take linear combinations and average two schedules, never average pair labels or pick a seed

uncertainty.unit: topic cluster; same sampled topic list in all8condition/schedule cells
uncertainty.method: percentile intervals with Bonferroni tails .05/(2*6); nominal99.1666666667% per interval

primary_family.limitations: Bonferroni percentile bootstrap intervals are approximate; ten topics and two schedules do not establish full sampling or generation variance

continuation: any nonbaseline condition is exploratory candidate only if its family-adjusted contrast vsR0N0 has mean>=1pp, lower bound>0 and both schedule deltas>0. Report all6 contrasts and all conditions regardless of outcome. No production promotion.
global_gate: All240events delivered once, complete stop, providerOpenAI, allowed declared Luna model, strict JSON list schema, known pair IDs/labels, unique logical/custom/served responseIDs, ten completed providerbatches each mixing all24slots, exact frozen bodies; else BLOCKED_VALIDITY, no target gold read or scientific metrics.
freeze: raw events, predictions and fixed-d1 fused decisions hashed with timestamp before opening target controls at runtime. D1 fixed public scores available independently of target labels.
